title: Jaula de Luz
prompt:
Generate original fantasy RPG catalog image 114, Jaula de Luz. Subject: Jaula de Luz: objeto mágico do dia a dia, com cara de coisa comum e um detalhe estranho. O que faz: prende qualquer coisa do tamanho de um cão enquanto houver luz.
Square 1:1: ONE complete isolated item, centered three-quarter view, practical handmade and worn, exaggerated voluminous iconic silhouette. No hands, person or mannequin.
Final image must have REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, NO backdrop color, NO white fill, NO painted checkerboard, NO atmospheric background, NO dark/brown vignette or fog halo, NO floor or cast shadow. Keep generous clear margins around the full silhouette and transparent gaps between separate parts. Style: modern independent comics and contemporary animation; dynamic organic expressive varied ink linework, clean lines mixed with energetic loose strokes; genuinely FLAT vibrant colors and simple hard BLOCK shadows, abundant printed HALFTONE and STIPPLING dots, handmade retro comic texture. Warm ochre/orange/earth browns balanced with cool blues/cyan/deep greens. Not realistic, not 3D, not oil/watercolor painting; no smooth airbrush gradients, photographic lighting or embossed realistic renders; no neon. Magic, if requested, is isolated flat graphic aura/overflowing aura with gaps/smoke curls/hard-light constructs with dotted glow. Value colors: Conflitüo rusty red; Sublimeyn mercury silver; Dominum dark purple; Persona coral; Alvorum gold/black; Morbidyum pale green; Cognitium indigo; Eternyr midnight blue with white streaks; Primitivum moss green/amber. Contrast warm magic with cool clothing/details and cold magic with warm clothing/details. Metal equipment is dark golden Bronze Arco where applicable. No text, typography, labels, logo, signature or watermark. Any fantasy combat is non-graphic with no visible injury or victims; human figures wear practical appropriate clothing.
